evidence.claim: UniFor del Gruppo Molteni produce dal 1969 sistemi di arredo per uffici, da Turate per musei, biblioteche e banche in tutto il mondo.
evidence.quote: UniFor, part of the Molteni Group, since it was founded in 1969, develops and produces furnishing systems designed to interpret the complexity of the workplace with simple solutions. || An international company with solid national roots, UniFor has been drawing direct lines between its Turate headquarters and major international centres since the 1970s. || With its furniture, UniFor gives life to museums, libraries, banks, corporations and institutions all over the world.
